name: Ellaktor S.A.
summary: Ellaktor S.A., through its subsidiaries, operates as an infrastructure company in Greece, other European countries, Gulf countries, and the Americas. The company operates through Concessions; and Real Estate Development and Services segments. It engages in various concessions activities, including financing, design, construction, maintenance, and operation of motorways, bridges, and marina. The company also undertakes the development, construction, and operation of windfarms and photovoltaic parks; and development of commercial parks, residential buildings, and exhibition centers, as well as office and mixed-use buildings.
